page.layout: One block of running text in a single column; left margin holds one note ("1.Tim.4.") beside the line "fuerunt juxta Apostoli Prophetiam"; right margin shows only the edge of the neighbouring page and show-through, which are left out.

main_text.p: quoniam resider in illis, & emicat pro ratione loci vel conditionis aliquis Divinitatis radius. Sic instructa procul dubio per Levitas & Prophetas haec turbata Militum rutuba fatius duxit, in re licita, licet non opportuna, vel necessaria simpliciter obtemperare, quam causari & cavillari, & de Mandantis Prudentia aut scopo, scrupulos mouere, unde factum, ut nemo manum ad os applicuerit, sed religione obstricti, abstinuerint & tam proposito & invitante edic-lio[?].

10 Obedientia igitur emicuit in Abstinentia, vidimus quoufq; sit obediendum; Limites etiam Abstinentiae sunt figendi, ne virtus tanti pretij in animi morbum degeneret. Pythagoreorum hac ex parte scrupulosa placita non licet discutere, quae apud Eusebium contra Hieroclem, Philostratum de Apollonio Tyanen, Iam-blicum de Mysteriis Aegyptiorum sunt obvia. Quid cum ad ortum lucis Evangelicae Elementa legis egena evanuissent, num de-1.Tim.4. fuerunt juxta Apostoli Prophetiam, inter Chri-stianos, qui in delectu quodam ciborum, & Matrimonij fuga, nescio quid Sanctitatis & meriti latere persuaderent? Hoc nomine licet merito

page.notes: Printed "edic-lio[?]" at the line end: the second part of the broken word is uncertain. A faint mark "y" is visible in the right margin beside the line "edic-lio"; it is not clearly a reference mark, so it is not transcribed. The text continues on the next page ("merito" and the sentence). Some spellings are uncertain: "Pytbagoreorum" may be printed with "Pytbago-", and "Tyanen," is read from a worn line; both are given as read. Right margin edge and show-through are omitted.
